user.title: Connect to Quartermaster
user.description: Create a token in Quartermaster under **Settings → New Home Assistant token** (admins only), then paste it here.

data_description.url: The address you open Quartermaster at in a browser, including http or https at the start.
data_description.token: Starts with qm_. Quartermaster shows it once, when you create it.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Quartermaster token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: {url} no longer accepts the saved token. Create a new one in Quartermaster under **Settings → New Home Assistant token**.

data_description.token: Starts with qm_. Quartermaster shows it once, when you create it.

reconfigure.title: Change the Quartermaster connection
reconfigure.description: Use this when Quartermaster moved to a new address. Leave the token empty to keep the current one.

data_description.url: The address you open Quartermaster at in a browser, including http or https at the start.
data_description.token: A new token, or empty to keep the current one.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Quartermaster at that address.
error.invalid_auth: Quartermaster rejected the token. Make sure it is a Home Assistant token, not a device token.
error.invalid_url: Enter the full address, starting with http:// or https://.
error.not_quartermaster: That address answers, but it isn't a Quartermaster server.
error.setup_required: This Quartermaster server hasn't been set up yet. Open it in a browser and finish setup first.

abort.already_configured: This Quartermaster server is already set up.

empty_item.message: Say or type what to add.

invalid_auth.message: Quartermaster rejected the token. Open the integration to enter a new one.

item_not_found.message: No item {item} on the Quartermaster list.

server_error.message: Quartermaster had a problem with the change: {error}

incompatible_server.title: Quartermaster server is newer than this integration
incompatible_server.description: {title} runs Quartermaster {version}, which speaks Home Assistant API {ha_api}, but this integration speaks {supported_ha_api}. Some features may not work. Update the Quartermaster integration (in HACS); this issue clears itself once the versions match.

server_unreachable.title: Quartermaster server unreachable
server_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant hasn't been able to reach Quartermaster at {url} ({title}) for over 30 minutes. The list in Home Assistant is unavailable until it can.

Check that the server is running. If it moved to a new address, open **Settings → Devices & services → Quartermaster**, choose the three-dot menu on the entry and **Reconfigure**. This issue clears itself once the server answers again.

stream_unavailable.title: Quartermaster live updates aren't working
stream_unavailable.description:
Quartermaster ({title}) answers, but its event stream hasn't connected for over 15 minutes (last error: {error}). Home Assistant falls back to checking the list every minute, so changes show up late and the `quartermaster_*` events don't fire.

This is almost always a reverse proxy buffering or closing `text/event-stream` responses on `/api/events`. Turn off response buffering for that path (for nginx, `proxy_buffering off;`) and make sure idle connections can stay open for at least 60 seconds. This issue clears itself once the stream connects.

unsupported_server_version.title: Quartermaster server is too old
unsupported_server_version.description: {title} runs Quartermaster {version}, which is older than this integration supports. Some features may not work. Update the Quartermaster server; this issue clears itself once it reconnects with a supported version.
